purpose: Shared conceptual knowledge base for the Brain so all workers use the same concepts, terminology, relationships, and abstractions.
boundaries: Store concepts, relationships, usage rules, confidence, and subsystem guidance; do not store raw article text as reusable memory.
Learn editorial craft and conceptual meaning, not publisher expression, source headline structure, or copied definitions.
Facts stay in Story Dossiers and evidence records; Learner Lexicon stores reusable understanding that helps workers reason and write.
Public dictionary, thesaurus, encyclopedia, and reference sources may inform meaning only after distillation into original Framework guidance.

attribution.definition: A claim or statement that identifies the evidence, person, document, or organization behind it.
attribution.writerGuidance: Attribute source-specific or not-yet-broadly-confirmed claims naturally inside the article; do not expose internal reporting mechanics.
attribution.validatorGuidance: Flag unsupported claims, vague source language, and internal process wording that reaches public copy.
attribution.consolidationRule: Merge duplicate observations into this concept instead of storing raw repeated experience.

verification.definition: The process of matching a claim to official records, independent reporting, direct statements, or multiple source confirmations.
verification.writerGuidance: Use stronger verbs such as confirmed only when the evidence layer supports that level of certainty.
verification.validatorGuidance: Route weak or unsupported facts back to the Evidence Engine instead of forcing a language-only repair.
verification.consolidationRule: Merge duplicate observations into this concept instead of storing raw repeated experience.

story-identity.definition: The primary actor, event, action, consequence, and category that define one publishable story.
story-identity.writerGuidance: Write from one clean event dossier; do not merge fragments from nearby but different events.
story-identity.validatorGuidance: Reject or repair headline/body mismatch, paragraph topic contamination, and wrong-category placement before publication.
story-identity.consolidationRule: Merge duplicate observations into this concept instead of storing raw repeated experience.

topic-isolation.definition: Keeping each article anchored to one event while preserving related context as background, not as a second story.
topic-isolation.writerGuidance: Use related articles only when they clarify the same event; move unrelated facts out before drafting.
topic-isolation.validatorGuidance: Classify mixed-topic paragraphs as repairable dossier failures, not terminal article failures.
topic-isolation.consolidationRule: Merge duplicate observations into this concept instead of storing raw repeated experience.

headline-body-alignment.definition: The headline's actor, action, and consequence must match the article's central event and body evidence.
headline-body-alignment.writerGuidance: Generate headlines from the completed story dossier and article body, not from publisher headlines.
headline-body-alignment.validatorGuidance: Repair the headline only when the body is sound; send the story back to dossier repair when the body and dossier disagree.
headline-body-alignment.consolidationRule: Merge duplicate observations into this concept instead of storing raw repeated experience.

lexical-precision.definition: Choosing words by evidence level, category, tone, and reader clarity instead of repeating generic phrases.
lexical-precision.writerGuidance: Use the Behavioral Lexicon to select verbs and transitions before the first draft; avoid template phrases and internal process language.
lexical-precision.validatorGuidance: Treat repeated generic terms, mojibake, incomplete words, and process leakage as repairable language failures.
lexical-precision.consolidationRule: Merge duplicate observations into this concept instead of storing raw repeated experience.

knowledge-distillation.definition: Turning raw experience into reusable concepts, skills, patterns, confidence updates, and future behavior changes.
knowledge-distillation.writerGuidance: Use distilled lessons as craft constraints, not as source content.
knowledge-distillation.validatorGuidance: Measure whether stored lessons changed future behavior and first-pass quality.
knowledge-distillation.consolidationRule: Merge duplicate observations into this concept instead of storing raw repeated experience.

actor-action-consequence-headline.useWhen: The story dossier has a clear actor and confirmed action.
actor-action-consequence-headline.avoidWhen: The event is still unverified or the actor is unknown.
actor-action-consequence-headline.repairGuidance: If the headline becomes word salad, rebuild who/what/consequence from the Story Dossier instead of rearranging source-title keywords.

fact-context-consequence-body.pattern: Verified fact -> necessary context -> consequence or next confirmed step
fact-context-consequence-body.useWhen: The article needs substance without opinion or internal process language.
fact-context-consequence-body.avoidWhen: The body lacks dossier evidence; request Evidence Engine expansion first.
fact-context-consequence-body.repairGuidance: Remove summary-repeat-body loops and replace them with distinct verified details from the dossier.

newsLab: Use concepts to keep article facts, headline, category, and image aligned to one event.
Do not publish public text about dossiers, source signals, confidence mechanics, or internal workflow.
Repair incomplete sentences, mojibake, generic placeholder language, and duplicate-event articles before publication.
creatorDesk: Use concepts to connect opinion to the specific facts of the day without repeating the same values paragraph.
Keep commentary distinct from News Lab fact reporting.
newsletter: Use concepts to vary weekly openings, transitions, and recap structure while preserving the weekly-summary mission.
Avoid repeating stories or recycling the same phrasing across issues.

consolidation.promoteWhen: A concept or technique repeatedly improves first-pass approval, repair success, public quality, or subsystem coordination.
consolidation.demoteWhen: A concept causes false positives, generic writing, topic drift, or publication stalls.

rule: Every subsystem may contribute to Learner Lexicon, but every stored item must be a reusable concept, technique, relationship, or confidence update.
